newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's bourse shut by strike over Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's bourse shut by strike over Kashmir.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange was shut on Wednesday because of a official strike to protest at what Pakistan calls India's occupation of Moslem-majority Kashmir.
On Tuesday, the Karachi 100-share index soared 50.74 points, or 3.18 percent, to end at 1,648 in a turnover of 87.25 million shares. Gainers beat losers 231 to 13.
Dealers said buying was fuelled by the landslide election win by Nawaz Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League.
